subject: reasoning
question: Manoj starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns right and drives 3 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Manoj starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards north.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns right and drives 3 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P.
